title: Airy Flaky Korean Farfalle Jjigae
description: A malty and flaky Korean Busan-style dish featuring farfalle, steamed with mushrooms and a crispy sesame crust, served in a ceramic tagine pot.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine farfalle pasta, Korean chili flakes, and a pinch of salt. Set aside.
In a small saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add Gochujang paste and sugar, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Simmer the paste mixture for 5 minutes, or until it thickens and darkens slightly.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add shredded mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt.
Add steamed water to the flour mixture and stir until a smooth, thick batter forms.
Pour the batter into the ceramic tagine pot and spread it evenly.
Add the mushroom mixture on top of the batter and spoon the farfalle pasta over the top.
Drizzle the Gochujang paste mixture over the farfalle and top with green onions.
Transfer the tagine pot to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes, or until the crust is crispy and golden brown.
